description: Democratic Republic of the Congo - Mining Sites is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries", published or maintained by Naichen Zhao (World Bank Group). Data collected and prepared from the Democratic Republic of Congo Power–Mining Map, for a WBG open knowledge repository book The Power of the Mine A Transformative Opportunity for Sub-Saharan Africa. Citation: “Banerjee, Sudeshna Ghosh; Romo, Zayra; McMahon, Gary; Toledano, Perrine; Robinson, Peter; Pérez Arroyo, Inés. 2015. Coverage: the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It has 3 files in GeoJSON, SHP ZIP, PDF. The portal files it under Extractive industries. The portal gives 2014 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
